item.title: The Global Tipping Points Report 2025 Part 7: Climate as Legal Imperative and the Judicialization of Policy
item.description: This installment addresses one of the most consequential shifts embedded in the report: the transformation of climate policy from a legislative choice into a legal obligation. Once climate stability is framed as a justiciable right, the arena of decision-making shifts from parliaments and voters to courts and legal doctrine.

item.title: Surprising Discovery: Sahara Is Greening…Billions of Trees Where Once Thought To Be Barren
item.description: This reminds us that nature is resilient and that our understanding of the Earth’s ecosystems is constantly evolving. The desert is not just a place of sand and heat—it is a place of hidden life, slowly reclaiming its ground.

item.title: Seven Lies We’re Told About Climate Change | Michael Shellenberger
item.description: Michael Shellenberger is one of the best communicators I have come across. Here he unpicks a lot of the myths around climate change.

item.title: Rooftop Solar Fraud: The Damage Continues (Part I)
item.description: The subsidy-infested rooftop solar industry is all about making a highly uneconomic enterprise economic through complicated long-term leasing contracts. Numerous leading rooftop solar firms are bankrupt. Part II tomorrow will update the mess created by the demise of Sunnova, the largest company in this solar space. Part III on Friday will share a social media exchange with a rooftop solar apologist where the weakest argument is mistakenly made rather than remaining silent.

item.title: RealClear Politics Is Right: The Climate Hoax Is a Massive Financial Scam
item.description: If more of the mainstream media had been willing to ask the right questions and lean in on realism instead of green washing, trillions could have been saved from this financial scam. RealClear Politics does a great service by publishing harsh but honest articles like Moore’s; other outlets should do the same.

item.title: The Global Tipping Points Report 2025 Part 8: Financialization of Climate Risk and Systemic Consequences
item.description: Complex systems demand humility. Restructuring global finance on the basis of uncertain nonlinear thresholds may prove to be its own form of tipping experiment.
